root_cause.statement: The causal eligibility rule was enforced only after another seven zero-effect pilots. Ranking now refuses one task without an exact denominator identity, but the assignment still targets a disabled executor and no runner-level refusal or successful causally eligible task is proven.

smallest_safe_corrective_action: Keep Morning System Upgrade disabled until an assignment includes immutable denominator_event_id, exact current-to-numerator transition, canonical project/repo/branch/route and implementation_authorized=true.
Require the implementation runner to fail closed on any missing eligibility field even if ranking emitted an assignment.
Return NO_COMPATIBLE_METRIC without implementation, PR, deployment or terminal receipt when no eligible event exists.

expected_effect.process: Stop zero-effect work at both ranking and execution boundaries and reserve the next implementation slot for an immutable-ledger-eligible outcome.
expected_effect.raw_target: The next accepted live-completion assignment is capable of moving the unchanged raw input from 1/4 to 2/4.
expected_effect.measurement: Compare the next accepted assignment with the current 0/32 gain baseline and re-read the exact immutable metric after canonical production verification.
expected_effect.credit_policy: No score, completion or product credit until canonical ACTUAL_EFFECT proves the raw change.

acceptance: assignment contains immutable denominator_event_id and exact numerator transition
task names canonical project, repo, branch and production route
implementation_authorized is true before an enabled executor starts
runner independently validates all eligibility fields and fails closed otherwise
NO_COMPATIBLE_METRIC consumes no implementation, PR or deployment slot
terminal receipt re-reads the same unchanged-formula metric
zero delta remains EVALUATED_NO_EFFECT with zero credit
